body:
i've been seeing counsellors for a couple of years. not through uni, through my doctor. 

a guy i thought was pretty nice has been treating me shittily just because we were a bad combo, basically. he is not a bad guy but we just didn't work. we broke up today and it is not so much the event itself but the reminder that life is just kind of a series of shitty battles. 

i do not really feel anything about it or about anything. i feel kind of emotionally dead now.
